GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 122.2 (6 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-394)
APO 500
6 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Proceeds of Remittances and Collections since 15 August 1945.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government will take immediate action to insure that no payment, transfer or withdrawal will be effected without the prior approval of this Headquarters from any bank account which was credited on or since 15 August 1945 with the proceeds of any remittance from or collection made in Korea if:
a. The remittance or collection with which the account was credited was in excess of 10,000 yen and;
b. The effect of such payment, transfer or withdrawal will be to reduce the balance in such account below the amount of the remittance or collection, or if the balance in such account on the date of receipt of this memorandum is below the amount of such remittance or collection.
2. An acknowledgment of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
